name: Storefront
tagline: Cream, espresso and terracotta with a golden accent: a warm small-business sales deck.

palette.description: warm cream with espresso ink, terracotta and a golden accent

typography.style: friendly serif headlines over a round sans

best_for: Selling a product or service from a small business: cafes, shops, studios, agencies and local services pitching customers or partners. Has slides for the problem, three offerings, how it works, why us, three price tiers, a testimonial, proof in numbers, an offer and a contact close.
avoid_for: Formal finance, research reports and technical reviews.
navigation: inline keyboard handler with on-page slide counter
